# CodeGym

> > CodeGym is an interactive online Java programming course featuring gamified learning through quests, practical coding tasks, and comprehensive coverage of OOP, collections, multithreading, and web development.

Created by HiTech Rush Inc., CodeGym offers a structured learning path from Java syntax basics to advanced topics, with support for multiple languages and an active community forum. The platform emphasizes hands-on practice with automated task verification using IntelliJ IDEA integration.

## Key Topics

- Java programming
- Object-oriented programming (OOP)
- Java Collections Framework
- Multithreading
- Inheritance and polymorphism
- Quest-based learning
- IntelliJ IDEA
- JDK 8
- Java syntax
- Web development with Java
- Beginner programming
- Spring Framework
- Data structures
- Type casting
- Automated code verification

## Core Java Tutorials

- [OOP Java](https://codegym.cc/groups/oop-java): Java OOP tutorial covering polymorphism, inheritance, composition principles
- [Inheritance in Java](https://codegym.cc/groups/inheritance-in-java): Java inheritance tutorial covering OOP, instanceof, type casting concepts
- [Java Collections](https://codegym.cc/groups/java-collections): Java Collections tutorial covering ArrayList, LinkedList, data structures
